description: This Java source file defines the 'TaxRate' entity class used in the sales management system. It models tax rate details including rate, priority, associated tax class, country, zone, and hierarchical relationships with other tax rates.

classes.name: TaxRate
classes.description: Entity class representing a tax rate, including attributes such as rate percentage, priority, applicable region, and relationships to tax class and hierarchical tax rates.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the TaxRate entity.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier for the TaxRate entity.

methods.name: getAuditSection
methods.description: Retrieves the audit section containing creation and modification info.

methods.name: setAuditSection
methods.description: Sets the audit section details.

methods.name: getTaxPriority
methods.description: Returns the priority of the tax rate.

methods.name: setTaxPriority
methods.description: Sets the priority for the tax rate.

methods.name: getTaxRate
methods.description: Returns the BigDecimal representing the tax rate percentage.

methods.name: setTaxRate
methods.description: Sets the tax rate percentage.

methods.name: isPiggyback
methods.description: Indicates whether this tax rate is piggybacked.

methods.name: setPiggyback
methods.description: Sets the piggyback status.

methods.name: getTaxClass
methods.description: Returns the tax class associated with this tax rate.

methods.name: setTaxClass
methods.description: Associates a tax class with this tax rate.

methods.name: getDescriptions
methods.description: Retrieves descriptions for the tax rate in different locales.

methods.name: setDescriptions
methods.description: Sets descriptions for the tax rate.

methods.name: getMerchantStore
methods.description: Returns the merchant store associated with this tax rate.

methods.name: setMerchantStore
methods.description: Associates a merchant store with the tax rate.

methods.name: setCountry
methods.description: Sets the country applicable for this tax rate.

methods.name: getCountry
methods.description: Returns the country associated with this tax rate.

methods.name: setZone
methods.description: Sets the zone (region) for the tax rate.

methods.name: getZone
methods.description: Returns the zone associated with the tax rate.

methods.name: setTaxRates
methods.description: Sets sub-tax rates, allowing nested tax rate structures.

methods.name: getTaxRates
methods.description: Returns sub-tax rates.

methods.name: setParent
methods.description: Defines the parent tax rate in hierarchy.

methods.name: getParent
methods.description: Returns the parent tax rate if any.

methods.name: setStateProvince
methods.description: Sets the state or province for regional tax rates.

methods.name: getStateProvince
methods.description: Returns the region/state code.

methods.name: setCode
methods.description: Sets the tax rate code identifier.

methods.name: getCode
methods.description: Returns the tax code.

methods.name: getRateText
methods.description: Provides a textual representation of the rate.

methods.name: setRateText
methods.description: Sets the textual description of the rate.
